test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 13 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
The line chart given below shows the marks obtained by two students P and Q in 6 subjects.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd6f221e39083ae086269c713e42b8610f2507eab7038297a69eb3f0ec51c502.png] 

Which of the following statement is correct?

I. The average of marks obtained by P in S1 and S2 is 70.

II. The ratio of marks obtained by Q in S3 to the marks obtained in S4 are 13 ∶ 7.
solution:
**Calculation:**

Statement I:

Marks obtained by S1 and S2 = 60 + 80 = 140

Average = 140/2 = 70

Statement I is true.

Statement II:

The ratio of marks obtained by Q in S3 to the marks obtained in S4 are 130 : 70 = 13 : 7

Statement II is true.

Both the statement is true.

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**
